subject: Compliance add-ons — split billing options & implementation asks
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Liz Porter <liz.porter@blueloomhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-19T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Compliance add-ons — initial packaging options

Hi Liz,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our discussion, I’m sending two straightforward packaging options for the compliance/security add-ons you asked about (audit logs, KMS/HSM, and EU residency):

Option A — Bundled recurring add-on (simpler PO):
- Monthly recurring fee that includes audit log retention (30 days), KMS integration, and EU residency routing.
- Implementation fee (one-time) to cover HSM on-boarding and evidence collection.
- Suggested price: $7k/month + $45k one-time implementation.

Option B — Split (transparent economics):
- Pass-through HSM seat cost (billed monthly at cost) + recurring audit-log storage fee.
- Implementation amortization: we can convert up to 50% of the implementation fee into monthly credits applied against the first 12 months if you take a 12-month minimum commit.
- Suggested price: $4k/month + $60k one-time, with up to $30k of that amortized as credits over 12 months for a 12-month commit.

A few clarifying points you raised:
- EU residency: we can route EU traffic to our EU pool. There’s typically a 10–15% regional surcharge on recurring fees to cover operator costs and local infra (we can tighten that number after sizing).
- Audit evidence delivery: we’ll provide evidence bundles (attested log exports + config docs) as part of the implementation milestone; further periodic evidence runs are available as add-on.

I attached a draft SOW and a preliminary evidence matrix so your legal/procurement folks can see the milestone/acceptance language.

If it helps, I can prepare a blended example that converts the implementation fee into a monthly line item (so total monthly impact is flat for year one) — that’s often easier for procurement than a large one-time charge.

What’s your preference here? If Option B looks reasonable, tell me what level of commit (12/24 months) you’d be comfortable with and I’ll run the math for credits.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-Compliance-v1.pdf (SOW draft), evidence-matrix.xlsx (implementation evidence checklist)

From: Liz Porter <liz.porter@blueloomhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@blueloomhealth.com
Date: 2028-04-19T19:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons — initial packaging options

Aditya —

Thanks for the clear options and the SOW. A few follow-ups from procurement and engineering:

1) Can you show an example amortization schedule for Option B that keeps the first-year monthly spend within a +/-10% band from our current projections? Our CFO prefers predictable monthly cost.
2) For the EU residency surcharge: is 10–15% on recurring the floor? We need a more prescriptive cap or a model by committed region throughput (e.g., up to X TB/month).
3) Is there any precedent for converting more than 50% of implementation into credits (we’d consider 75% if we commit 24 months) — what does Redwood typically do?

Also attaching our procurement template (procurement_template_BLH.docx) — please send a SOW v2 with milestone language adjusted for amortization (e.g., implementation deliverables but payment applied as credits monthly).

If you can get back with a table by EOD tomorrow we’ll brief the CFO.

Best,
Liz
Senior Procurement Manager
BlueLoom Health

Attachment: procurement_template_BLH.docx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-19T20:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Compliance add-ons — pricing asks (internal)

Ben/Laura — forwarding Liz’s asks. Key negotiation levers: amortization %, commitment length, and regional surcharge cap. I drafted an internal proposal below; please reply with approval/edits quickly — procurement expects a table tomorrow.

Draft proposal (numbers illustrative):
- Base recurring (US): $5,000/mo (includes audit log baseline + KMS)
- EU surcharge: +12% on recurring (capped at 15% for incremental traffic up to 5TB/mo, then review)
- Implementation fee: $48,000 one-time
- Credit conversion: 50% amortized over 12 months (standard); 75% amortized over 24 months if customer signs 24-month committed ARR.
- HSM seats: billed at cost + 10% handling fee. We do not waive HSM seat fees but can offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to 20% of the first-year seat cost for 24-months commit.

Rationale: preserves some upfront implementation revenue while giving procurement the monthly smoothing they want. Fully amortizing the entire implementation into credits is risky for early deployment support.

Approve the approach? If yes, I’ll create SOW v2 language where implementation is invoiced but a contra credit line (credit_code: BLH-IMPL-2028) applies monthly until amortized. I propose we also include a milestone-based evidence delivery schedule (M1: HSM onboarding; M2: evidence bundle; M3: residency routing verification).

Thanks,
Aditya

---
Ben replied inline:

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-19T20:22:00-07:00

Aditya — I like the 50/75% ladder. A couple of tweaks: increase handling fee on HSM seats to 15% (covers provisioning + SRE hours) and set EU surcharge cap language to: "surcharge applies up to 5TB/month at 12%; incremental usage reviewed monthly". Also, add a clause that credits are forfeited if customer terminates early (standard).

Laura — can you sign off on the SOW milestone language (evidence acceptance criteria)?

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Liz Porter <liz.porter@blueloomhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons — split billing options & implementation asks

Liz — thanks for the quick turn.

Based on your ask and internal approvals, here’s a concrete proposal we can table to your CFO tomorrow:

Summary table (finalizable in SOW v2):
- Recurring (US): $5,000/mo
- EU surcharge: +12% on recurring (capped at 15% for up to 5TB/mo; incremental usage reviewed monthly)
- Implementation: $48,000 one-time
- Credit conversion options:
  • 12-month commit: 50% of implementation ($24k) amortized over 12 months => $2,000/mo credit for 12 months
  • 24-month commit: 75% of implementation ($36k) amortized over 24 months => $1,500/mo credit for 24 months (lower monthly hit)
- HSM seats: billed at cost + 15% handling fee; onboarding credit: 20% of first-year seat spend for 24-month commit only
- Termination: credits are contingent on term; prorated forfeiture on early termination

Next steps: I attached SOW-Compliance-v2.pdf with the amortization language and milestone/acceptance criteria per Laura’s checklist. If this aligns, I’ll route the SOW for signature (DocuSign link below) and we can draft a PO based on the 12- or 24-month option you choose.

DocuSign: https://redwood.app/docusign/BLH-SOW-2028
Drive (evidence matrix): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/BLH-evidence-matrix

If you want me to model exact monthly totals for your finance team I can send a short amortization spreadsheet.

Appreciate it —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
